summary: Bright Horizons Family Solutions Inc. filed an 8-K on June 1, 2026 regarding a Fifth Amendment to its existing credit agreement. The amendment adds $375 million in incremental Term A Loans and increases the revolving credit facility from $900 million to $1 billion. Proceeds were used to repay outstanding revolving loans and pay fees. Terms include interest rates: Term Benchmark plus 1.25%-1.75% or Base Rate plus 0.25%-0.75%. This is a routine debt refinancing not a special situation, as it involves no acquisition, divestiture, or change in control.
